newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise on weak yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise on weak yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures extended early gains to end higher across the board on Wednesday, boosted by private investors' short-covering reflecting the yen's dip against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.8 yen to 2.4 yen per kg higher. Benchmark August was up 2.3 yen at 156.3 yen.
"Today's gains were led mainly by short-covering. Market players are tending to put money into other commodities like grains and precious metals," one trader said.
A continued fall in open interest of rubber futures in recent days suggests thin interest in rubber futures, he said.
